title: Air Rifles Recalled by DIANA Can Unexpectedly Discharge; Risk of Serious Injury and Death
summary: The air rifle can unexpectedly discharge even if the safety is engaged. This can result in a serious injury or death. Units: About 1,400.

title: Healing Solutions Recalls Essential Oils Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirements; Risk of Poisoning
summary: The bottles are not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act, posing a poisoning risk if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 32,000.

title: Ragdoll & Rockets Recalls Children's Loungewear Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The children's loungewear fails to meet the flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 14,100.

title: MW Company Recalls MOMO Quick Release Steering Wheel Adapters Due to Crash Hazard; Risk of Serious Injury and Death
summary: The steering wheel adapter's quick release can activate inadvertently and cause the race car's steering wheel to suddenly detach from its steering column while the vehicle is in motion, rendering the vehicle impossible to steer and posing a crash hazard and risk of serious injury and death to the dr

title: STIHL PolyCut Mowing Heads Recalled Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The bolts connecting the plastic blades and holding the mowing head together can come loose and the mowing head can come apart, posing a risk of injury to the user or bystanders. Units: About 73,000.

title: Walker Edison Furniture Recalls Children's Bunk Beds Due to Fall and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The bunk bed's support boards can break, posing fall and injury hazards. Units: About 1,200 (in addition, about 26 were sold in Canada).

title: Artizen Oils Recalls Essential Oils Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirements, Risk of Poisoning
summary: The bottles are not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act, posing a poisoning risk if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 6,000.

title: Gator Utility Vehicles Recalled by John Deere Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The plastic sheathing on the throttle cable can melt due to improper routing, causing the throttle to stick. This could result in the operator not being able to stop the vehicle, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 19,730 (In addition, about 840 were sold in Canada).

title: John Deere Recalls Frontier Grooming Mowers Due to Entanglement Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Incorrect assembly of the mower's drivelines can prevent the safety shield from spinning independently, posing an entanglement injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 730 (in addition, about 20 were sold in Canada).

title: Kawasaki USA Recalls Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: Incorrect joint assembly can cause steering control loss, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 2,600.

title: The Beaufort Bonnet Company Recalls Handmade Knit Dolls Due to Injury Hazard
summary: A sewing needle was discovered in the stuffing of one of the handmade knit dolls, posing a puncture injury hazard. Units: About 4,500.

title: ASKO Recalls Dishwashers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The dishwasher power cord can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 26,600 (in addition, about 4,300 were sold in Canada).

title: DeWALT Recalls Utility Bars Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The utility bar can break while being used for prying, posing an injury hazard to the user. Units: About 145,000.

title: Home Meridian Recalls Three-Drawer Chests Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards
summary: The recalled chests are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing serious tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in death or injuries to children. The chests do not comply with the performance requirements of the U.S. voluntary industry standard (ASTM F2057-17). Units: About 640

title: Chronicle Recalls Power Armor Collectible Helmets Due to Risk of Mold Exposure (Recall Alert)
summary: Mold can be present on the fabric insert inside the helmet, posing a risk of respiratory or other infections in individuals with compromised immune systems, damaged lungs or an allergy to mold. Units: About 20,000.

title: Exploding Kittens Recalls Safety Goggles Sold with Extreme Edition Dodgeball Game Sets Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively on Kickstarter (Recall Alert)
summary: The goggles contain glass lenses, posing a laceration hazard if shattered. Units: About 10,500 (In addition, about 735 in Canada).

title: Kichler Lighting Recalls Pendant Lights Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The light sockets can overheat, melt, or catch fire, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 750 (In addition, 289 were sold in Canada).

title: Humanscale Recalls QuickStand Lite Workstations Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The recalled workstation's arm can break and cause the workstation to fall, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 22,700 (In addition, about 2,200 were sold in Canada).
